value.rationale: The two adjacent antipodal apex-pair deformation is the first natural multi-apex cubical example beyond the single-pair case singled out by the motivating paper. The theorem gives a complete sharp Mahler profile on its whole unbounded parameter domain and discovers two strict interior peaks separated by a non-differentiable phase boundary. This gives a nonroutine, exact structural benchmark not implied by local cube minimality or the source lower bounds.
